title: RANKX optional arguments can be skipped with empty commas
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( Player, "Rank", RANKX ( Player, Player[Score], , , DENSE ) )

source.quote: Optional arguments might be skipped by placing an empty comma (,) in the argument list
source.supports: value and order are left out, ties is given

source.quote: The next rank value, after a tie, is the next rank value.

derivation: Player scores: Ann 90, Bob 80, Cho 80, Dee 70, Eve 70, Fay 50. With value and order omitted the row score is ranked descending; dense ranks over 90, 80, 70, 50 are 1, 2, 3, 4.
